briefing.headline: OpenAI o4 and DeepSeek R2 escalate frontier race with multi-agent breakthroughs

sections.label: EXECUTIVE SUMMARY
sections.text: The AI race has intensified with multiple frontier labs releasing advanced reasoning models in June. Funding remains robust while safety concerns mount around agentic systems. Global compute buildout continues at unprecedented scale.

sections.label: FRONTIER MODELS
sections.text: OpenAI deployed o4 with 2.1T parameters achieving new SOTA on agentic benchmarks. Anthropic's Claude 4 Opus launched alongside Meta's Llama 4 405B. DeepSeek R2 and xAI Grok-3 both entered production this week.

sections.label: SAFETY & SECURITY
sections.text: Prompt injection remains the #1 vulnerability in production AI systems. DialectForge's dynamic dialect negotiation is designed to solve injection at the protocol level across multi-agent, automotive, and BCI deployments.

sections.label: COMPUTE & INFRASTRUCTURE
sections.text: NVIDIA announced Blackwell Ultra shipments ramping to 500k units monthly. Microsoft and Google both broke ground on new 5GW AI data centers in Texas and Arizona.

sections.label: STRATEGIC QUESTION
sections.text: Will the first truly agentic AGI system emerge from a US lab or a Chinese consortium by end of 2027?
